0.0: You're back. I'm just about done with the sword for #p2101000#. Take a look. It's more of an accessory than a sword, but for a dancer, this is the ultimate prop. Will you accept it?

yes.0: #p2101000# is a smart young woman. She used the very first sword I made her for her very first dance. If not for the Queen's tyranny, I would've given her a sword as a gift. Please take this sword to #b#p2101000##k right now. Your kindness shall not go un-rewarded.

no.0: Are you busy with something? Sirin is waiting for her sword...

1.0: Did you go see #p2100001#? Did you get the fancy dancer sword for me? Wow! So these are the #t4031569#! Amazing!

yes.0: Thank you! This will let me enter the castle with more pizzazz than anyone. I WILL enter the castle. I will be #p2101000#, the greatest dancer of #m260000000#, performing in front of the Sultan. You just wait and see!

npc.0: You still haven't gone to #b#p2101000##k, yet? I'm sure she's eager to see the new sword... Please deliver these #t4031569# to #p2101000#.

item.0: You still haven't gone to #b#p2100001##k, yet? Find an old man who looks stubborn. His sword-making is the best in town, so ask him to make one for me.

lost.0: What are you thinking? I took all that time and effort to make one for you, and you lose it? Good thing this person I knew picked it up and returned it to me... What would you do if that person didn't do that? Anyway, please give this to #b#p2101000##k.

QuestInfo.name: Deliver the Fancy Sword
QuestInfo.1: You got #t4031569# from #p2100001#. Unlike other swords, this blade is dull, yet light and beautifully decorated. It should look good on #p2101000#.
QuestInfo.2: After receiving the new sword, #p2101000# confidently declared she will one day perform in the castle. Will all this preparation, she should be accepted into the palace...
